headline: Qusar district features high nature index and mountain terrain.

tags.reason: The nature index reaches 88 points, with forest cover at 18.1 percent and mountain terrain at 1049 metres elevation.
There are 6.49 schools per 10,000 residents compared to the national median of 4.14.

summary: Qusar is a mountain district with a population of 103,200 and a density of 69 people per square kilometre. It shows strong scores for nature at 88 points and comfort at 75 points. The paved road share of known surfaces stands at 7.3 percent against the national median of 4.35 percent. Price data is not available in the listings for this district.
